Unlike the 1Q2026 file (scanned), this file has a text layer; figures read from the page text and checked against the page totals (file page numbers). Reviewed, not audited (KPMG). Units differ: the SCI (three months p.6, six months p.8) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. Revenue 7.1.1 p.56 and expenses p.57 (columns non-PAA / PAA / total; six months). The CSM insurance-finance row in profit or loss is +266,331 year to date (1Q2026 alone was (63,965)). Income tax: the six-month column, labelled 'expense (income)', prints a credit in brackets (profit before tax + credit = net profit), stored as a credit (+); the three-month column, labelled 'expense', prints an expense positive (stored negative). RA release uses 7.1.1 (20,710), equal to the AOC RA. Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the SCI for the three months to 30 June 2569 (p.6).
